name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You have unearthed pieces of forbidden knowledge. You know 1 Eldritch Invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome, which imbues you with an abiding magical ability. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another one for which you qualify.

name: Pact Magic
description: Your pact with a mysterious entity grants you the ability to cast Warlock spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You know 2 cantrips and have 2 prepared level-1 spells; you can replace one cantrip or one prepared spell whenever you gain a Warlock level. You can use an Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.
